In `build_runner` 2.15.0, `--delete-conflicting-outputs` is accepted for compatibility and ignored. Keep the pinned version and run the repository’s documented generation command. If it uses the standard command, run this from the Flutter package root. [build_runner 2.15.0 flag handling](https://github.com/dart-lang/build/blob/build_runner-v2.15.0/build_runner/lib/src/build_runner.dart#L114-L121)

```sh
dart run build_runner build
```

1. Check `git status --short` before running the build so you can distinguish pre-existing changes from regeneration.
2. If generation fails, use the error to identify the file and generator involved. Make any needed fixes in the annotated source or generator configuration, then rerun the build. Leave generated files to the generator.
3. Review `git status --short` and `git diff` afterward. Confirm the generated changes match the model declarations and investigate any unexpected changes.
4. Format any Dart source you edited, run `flutter analyze`, and run the narrowest relevant tests with `flutter test <test-path>`. Cover serialization or `copyWith` behavior if the regenerated models expose it.
